pr_title: Treat cache failure action as a cache miss

issue_context.title: remote: treat failed actions as a cache miss
issue_context.body: If a remote cache returns a failed action (exit code != 0) then Bazel should treat this as a cache miss and attempt to re-execute the action. See for details https://gitlab.com/BuildGrid/buildgrid/issues/151
comments: We need to fix this for remote execution and caching across all protocols. In the case of remote execution, we'll also need to set `skip_cache_lookup` to `true` in order to ensure re-execution.

review_comments: why do you think the asserts below this line are valuable for the test?

We need to verify, that current action indeed treated as a cash miss => we do not attempt to download anything. 
Asserts in line 528-529 are obsolete, removing them.

Whether or not something is being downloaded seems orthogonal to what should be tested here. I'd argue that all this test should verify is that it's indeed a cache miss. We then have a separate unit test that verifies what should/should not happen on a cache miss.
